title: Your First Weekend at Centre College, Shared as Cards
description: Navigate your first days as a Colonel with this sequence of orientation traditions, campus landmarks, and essential student hangouts in Danville.

cards.title: Move-In and Check-In
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Kickoff
cards.notes: Arrive between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM to check into your residence hall and meet your First-Year Mentor who helps with the transition.
cards.short_summary: The official start of orientation where students move into campus housing and meet their mentors.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-in and check-in for new students is scheduled from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM on the first Friday of orientation.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation Schedule - Danville - Centre College
cards.access_notes: Open to incoming students and families during designated morning hours.

cards.title: Campus Connections Resource Fair
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Discovery
cards.notes: Visit the resource fair from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM to learn about campus organizations and student services available to you.
cards.short_summary: An afternoon fair introducing new students to various campus resources and involvement opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Connections Resource Fair is held from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM on Friday afternoon during orientation.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation Schedule - Danville - Centre College
cards.access_notes: Held outdoors on the lawn or inside the Roush Campus Center depending on weather.

cards.title: Barb's Bodacious 80's Bash
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Social
cards.notes: Head to this themed social event starting at 9:00 PM to meet your classmates in a relaxed, high-energy environment.
cards.short_summary: A signature Friday night orientation social event featuring 1980s-themed music and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Barb's Bodacious 80's Bash is a scheduled orientation event from 9:00 PM to 11:30 PM on Friday night.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation Schedule - Danville - Centre College
cards.access_notes: Late-night event specifically for orientation participants.

cards.title: Delve into Danville
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Exploration
cards.notes: Explore the local shops and murals of downtown Danville from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM to get familiar with your new home town.
cards.short_summary: A guided orientation program that introduces first-year students to the businesses and culture of downtown Danville.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Delve into Danville' program is scheduled for Saturday morning from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation Schedule - Danville - Centre College
cards.access_notes: Walking tour starting from campus into the downtown district.

cards.title: Lunch at Cowan
cards.subtitle: The Main Dining Hub
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the Roush Campus Center; it's the primary all-you-care-to-eat destination for students on campus.
cards.short_summary: The central dining hall at Centre College, offering various food stations and communal seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowan Dining Commons is the main dining facility located within the Roush Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours are typically 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Live from Centre
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Performance
cards.notes: Experience a live performance at Newlin Hall; students get free tickets to world-class touring acts throughout the year.
cards.short_summary: A premier performing arts venue on campus hosting concerts, theater, and student convocations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Norton Center for the Arts hosts orientation performances like 'Live from Centre' and provides free tickets to students.
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for free ticket scanning starting at 6:30 PM for evening shows.

cards.title: Centre Explore
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning History
cards.notes: Tour the historic heart of campus, including Old Centre, which has served the college since its opening in 1820.
cards.short_summary: A morning orientation session focused on navigating campus facilities and learning college history.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Centre Explore' session is held Sunday morning from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM during orientation.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation Schedule - Danville - Centre College
cards.access_notes: Focuses on administrative and historic buildings near the main lawn.

cards.title: Workout at Sutcliffe Hall
cards.subtitle: Afternoon Recreation
cards.notes: Use your student ID to swipe into the fitness center for a workout; it's open until midnight most days.
cards.short_summary: The primary student fitness facility featuring weight rooms, cardio equipment, and courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buck Fitness Center in Sutcliffe Hall is open to students with swipe access from 5:00 AM to 12:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center General - Centre College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for entry; Sunday hours for the main hall are 1:00 PM to 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Hollywood Casino Night
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Entertainment
cards.notes: Join the class for a night of mock-casino games and social interaction at the Combs Center from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A popular orientation social event featuring non-monetary casino games and prizes.
cards.evidence_claim: Hollywood Casino Night is a scheduled orientation activity on Sunday night from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation Schedule - Danville - Centre College
cards.access_notes: Late-night event for students; no real gambling involved.

cards.title: Coffee at Einstein's
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Prep
cards.notes: Visit Crounse Hall to find the library and the adjacent Einstein Bros. Bagels, a favorite spot for coffee and study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library which also houses the Centre Learning Commons and a popular bagel shop.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein Bros. Bagels is located on the main floor of the Grace Doherty Library in Crounse Hall.
cards.access_notes: Einstein's is open Monday-Friday starting at 7:30 AM.
